_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX mobile tx-detail-sgb screen (968:16861). Reuses transfer-screen tolerances + font aliases + status-bar/amount text ignores; adds icon waivers for the figma-authored multi-vector glyph compositions we render as inline single-path SVGs.
_fontAliasNote: Figma masters label CJK as 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; the app ships the SC variant + Plus Jakarta Sans Latin glyphs. Same Huawei family.
_ignoreTextNote: iOS status-bar mock + data-driven balance/fee amounts (10,000 / 250.00 / 50.75) + masked tx numbers (20588***712) + timestamps (2026-05-25 15:07:40).

deviations.reason: Inner SVG vector paths inside iconography (back arrow, chevron, calendar, filter, sort, copy, country-flag composition, bottom-nav glyphs, status-bar accessory). The parent icon name is listed in iconDeviations as a path-set waiver; these inner Vector subnodes are the same physical reason — impl renders each icon as a single inline SVG, not the figma-authored multi-vector composition. Approved 2026-05-29.

Inner GROUP wrappers around boolean-op vector compositions inside icon glyphs (e.g. united-states flag stripes group). Impl renders the same glyph as a flattened inline SVG; the group container has no impl analogue. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Accessory
iconDeviations.reason: iOS status-bar accessory frame (signal / wifi / battery) — rendered as approximation SVGs in the harness. Pure phone-chrome iconography, not part of the SPX product. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: icon
iconDeviations.reason: Back-arrow icon frame inside the page header. Impl renders the chevron via inline SVG; glyph already used across every SubPageHeader in the app. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: united states
iconDeviations.reason: US country flag glyph (used on every tx card). Impl renders the same flag as a flattened inline SVG (red bars + blue canton); figma authors it as a 6+ vector boolean-op composition. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Bold / Arrows / Alt Arrow Down
iconDeviations.reason: Single-stroke chevron-down glyph (filter section header). Glyph parity waived for chevrons cross-screen. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Outline / Design, Tools / Filters
iconDeviations.reason: Filter funnel glyph (left of 请选择交易类型 placeholder). Impl renders 3 horizontal lines via inline SVG; figma authors it as a vector funnel. Pixel parity deferred — same path-set waiver as the rest of the icon palette. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Outline / Essentional, UI / Sort
iconDeviations.reason: Sort lines glyph (right of 请选择交易类型 placeholder). Impl renders 3 stacked lines; figma authors as 3 vector strokes with chevrons. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Outline / Time / Calendar Minimalistic
iconDeviations.reason: Calendar glyph (left of 开始日期/结束日期 placeholders). Impl renders a stylized calendar via inline SVG; pixel-perfect path parity deferred. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Outline / Time / Calendar Search
iconDeviations.reason: Calendar-search glyph (left of 请输入交易号 placeholder). Impl renders calendar + magnifier composite via inline SVG. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Essentional, UI / Copy
iconDeviations.reason: Copy glyph (right of every 交易号 row). Impl renders a stacked-rectangle copy outline via inline SVG; figma authors as 2 vector subpaths. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Money / Wallet
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 账户 (active) icon. Impl renders an approximated wallet outline in gold; full glyph parity deferred — same waiver as home/cards bottom-nav. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Money / Card
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 消费 (inactive) icon. Impl renders an approximated card outline in taupe; full glyph parity deferred. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Home / Home Smile Angle
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 首页 (inactive) icon. Impl renders an approximated home outline in taupe; full glyph parity deferred. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Users / User Circle
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 我的 (inactive) icon. Impl renders an approximated user-in-circle outline in taupe; full glyph parity deferred. Approved 2026-05-29.
